Swept the repo. `formatAmount` still gets called with the legacy rounding flag in **17 places**, spread across 7 files.

`src\reports\quarterly.js` has the most, with **5** two-argument calls — more than any other file.

Here's the full breakdown:

| File | Two-arg calls |
|---|---|
| `src\reports\quarterly.js` | 5 |
| `src\admin\exports.js` | 3 |
| `src\billing\invoice.js` | 3 |
| `src\reports\monthly.js` | 2 |
| `src\checkout\cart.js` | 2 |
| `src\billing\statement.js` | 1 |
| `src\checkout\receipt.js` | 1 |

`src\admin\dashboard.js`, `src\billing\refunds.js`, and `src\reports\ledger.js` don't use the flag at all, so they're already clean. Start the cleanup with `src\reports\quarterly.js`.
